name: Toast
job: Keep the one standing guard of a page in view (a stop-loss, a limit) without putting it in the reading order twice, and let the reader dismiss it for the session.

anatomy.role: Fixed bottom right, elevated surface, border in its one meaning
Mono caps at the label step, in the frame's colour
A 44px icon button labelled Dismiss; Escape also closes it
The guard itself, one or two sentences
When it was set and by what

states.name: Limit
states.note: A stop-loss or a budget line: gold, because it is a limit, not a failure.

states.name: Failed check
states.note: Only when a check has failed and the reader must act.

use_when: A page has exactly one guard the reader must not lose while scrolling.
The guard is already decided; the toast reminds, it does not ask.
avoid_when: Do not stack toasts; a second guard belongs in the page.

Do not use red for a limit. Colour has one meaning across the kit (arc weld spec 4.3): red a failed check, gold a limit, green proven, cyan an action or focus, plain (steel) unknown, magenta a paradox.
Do not put an action that sends or publishes in a toast.

data.note: `gold` for a limit, `red` only for a failed check.
`meta` names the time and what set the guard.

access: `role="status"`, so it is announced once and does not steal focus.
The close button has an `aria-label`; Escape closes it; the dismissal is kept for the session only, and the page still works with storage blocked.
Reduced motion drops the slide in. Print places it in the flow at the end of the page.

gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`kit_primitive_sync.py --check`: every page that marks this block carries it line for line.
`artifact_wrap_lint.py` and `page_gate.py` on every page that carries it; sweep 360 to 1440, including 700 to 1000.
